name: Number of distinct values in the list of values of the Euler totient function {phi(j) : j=1..n}.
link: Michael De Vlieger, Table of n, a(n) for n = 1..10000 (first 1000 terms from T. D. Noe.)
Erdős problems database contributors, Erdős problem database, see no. 417.
Terence Tao, Monotone non-decreasing sequences of the Euler totient function, arXiv:2309.02325 [math.NT], 2023.
example: a(1) = 1 since phi(1) = 1 is distinct from phi(k), k < 1.
a(3) = 2 since phi(3) = 2, distinct from phi(1) = phi(2) = 1.
a(5) = 3 since phi(5) = 4, distinct from phi(k), k < 5, etc. (End)
